# Specify Instructions Template

**Note:** This template is for reference only. The actual specify-instructions.md file is generated by the `/speckit.scope` command (Q7: PR Breakdown) with the appropriate content based on whether incremental mode (with breakdown) or full mode (no breakdown) is selected.

See `guides/scope/q7-breakdown.md` → Step 7 for the actual templates used.

## File Location

Generated file: `specs/[service-name]-specify-instructions.md`

## Two Modes

### Incremental Mode (has breakdown.md)
- Points to breakdown.md for current sub-scope
- Instructs to generate spec for current sub-scope only
- References specification.md for technical decisions

### Full Mode (no breakdown.md)
- Points to specification.md directly
- Instructs to generate spec for complete connector
- Single PR workflow
